body:
Redline round 2

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (1a7bf67..515f7a7) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 1 fix changes one check in tests/loop-test.mjs. It drops the clause that looked for a doubled word joiner, which could never fail: postedText adds a joiner only before an ASCII letter or digit, so a joiner left behind would never sit next to a new one. It also renames the check to say what it now asserts. The new comment's claim holds, because the carry-list check at line 1760 still pins the joiner strip, and the fix introduces no correctness bug.

No findings.
